files..github/workflows/delivery.yml:
name: Deliver cedar
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  delivery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/deliver
        with:
          lane: guarded
files..github/actions/deliver/action.yml:
name: Deliver service
description: Select and execute a delivery lane
inputs:
  lane:
    description: Delivery lane
    required: true
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - shell: bash
      env:
        DELIVERY_LANE: ${{ inputs.lane }}
      run: bash scripts/deliver.sh

name: Deliver service classic
description: Previous delivery action
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - shell: bash
      run: bash scripts/lanes/direct.sh
